notes:
Takeoff, round two: condition types, a proper setup screen, and a cover sheet.

- **Condition type.** Linear, Wall, Footing/curb, Curve, Area, Floor, Ceiling,
  Concrete slab, Roof, Count — or Typed for things you don't draw. A wall is
  drawn as runs and comes out in square feet from its height (one or both
  sides); a floor or ceiling gives square feet and its perimeter; a slab or
  footing gives cubic yards. Every quantity is shown, and "Price per" picks the
  one it is priced on.

- **The setup screen** now has notes; a color grid with a row of the colors
  already in the job; line thickness on screen or in real inches at the
  sheet's scale (more sizes); a fill opacity and a hatch pattern for areas; a
  shape — drag out a rectangle, circle, triangle, pentagon, hexagon or octagon,
  or click a custom one out; marker shapes for counts. Group and Area are lists
  of everything you have made, with "New…" at the bottom.

- **One piece at a time.** Each count point and each segment of a run has its
  own small box. Click one to pick it, drag to move just it, Delete to remove
  it (a run splits where the segment was). Cmd, Ctrl or Shift adds another.

- **Right-click a condition** for: take off with it, edit, notes, show its
  takeoffs, move to a group, assign an area, hide, duplicate, delete. Groups
  have their own menu.

- **Curve** conditions follow the drawn line between your clicks, so a curved
  wall or property line is a few clicks.

- **Cover sheet** (Pages → Cover sheet, or Job ▾): bid information and the plan
  organizer. Sheets are numbered, named and filed by discipline. Add one or more
  sheets from another PDF without copying the rest, keep only the sheets the job
  needs, or replace one with a revised version — its takeoff stays, flagged to
  check. Prints as a cover sheet with the sheet index.

- Area opacity now changes the inside of the shape, and "Fill the shape" works.
  Fills, hatches, marker shapes and real-inch lines come out on the marked-up
  PDF too. The color square opens the grid; "More colors…" is the system picker.

- These notes are readable now: full size and properly formatted, instead of
  three lines of small text at the bottom of the screen.

- **Updates never touch your work.** An update replaces the app and its own
  download folder and nothing else; a half-downloaded update is refused instead
  of installed. (The "damaged or incomplete" app on Nov 1 was this.)
